# jurisdiction determinacy

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:jurisdictionDeterminacy`](gmeow-jurisdictionDeterminacy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/jurisdictionDeterminacy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The ontic determinacy model of this jurisdiction claim — crisp (well-defined border), vague (approximate boundary), fuzzy (probabilistic membership), or disputed (competing claims). Non-functional: sources may disagree on determinacy, and those claims coexist.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:JurisdictionTenure`](../classes/gmeow-JurisdictionTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the ontic determinacy model of a jurisdiction claim — crisp, vague, fuzzy, or disputed; a subproperty of [`gmeow:hasDeterminacy`](gmeow-hasDeterminacy.md), non-functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with epistemic confidence (a separate axis) — this records the nature of the boundary/claim.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:jurisdictionDeterminacy`](gmeow-jurisdictionDeterminacy.md) to a [`gmeow:Determinacy`](../classes/gmeow-Determinacy.md) individual; sources may disagree and those claims coexist.
